title: How to count characters in a cell
task: Character count for a cell — with or without spaces — for limits, validation, or SMS/tweet length.
keywords: count length of cell google sheets

excel.note: Counts everything including spaces. Without spaces: =LEN(SUBSTITUTE(A2," ","")).

explanation: LEN returns the total number of characters, spaces and punctuation included — "hello world" is 11. To exclude spaces, remove them first: =LEN(SUBSTITUTE(A2," ","")) gives 10. LEN counts a leading/trailing space too, which is why =LEN(A2)-LEN(TRIM(A2)) is a quick way to detect stray padding. For a whole column's total, wrap in SUMPRODUCT: =SUMPRODUCT(LEN(A2:A100)). (Note LENB counts bytes, which differs from LEN only for double-byte languages.)
